name: Secret Parcel
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
A failed removal of an old backup no longer reports a failed backup.
A fast second Remove click no longer removes the next profile.
changes_user: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
If an old backup cannot be removed, the new backup no longer shows as failed.
A fast second click on Remove no longer removes the next profile too.
tip: In the import preview, leave a conflict unticked to keep the value that is already in this vault.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Secret Parcel is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it with your files.
